brief: J.P. Morgan US Market Intelligence publishes on CPI morning. In-line August PPI, 0.4% month on month headline and 0.2% core with core at 4.6% year on year, left OIS pricing for a 25bp September hike near 67%, so CPI becomes the deciding input and 0.2% versus 0.3% rounded core is the threshold. Feroli forecasts headline +0.38% and core +0.21%, which he reads as low enough to hold. The desk maps core outcomes to one-day SPX moves, from a 1.5% to 2.5% decline above 0.30% to a 1.5% to 2% gain below 0.15%, against options pricing about 1.0%. Because positioning is neutral and hedge funds added gross exposure on 4 of the past 5 days, +1.3z on the week, a Hold or Hawkish Hold should lift Momentum, Tech and Cyclicals and skew risk/reward upside. The desk still holds Tactically Cautious / Neutral into the September 16 FOMC with an unchanged Monetization Menu: long NDX versus short RTY, Mag7 over Semis, short credit ETFs, long VIX. WTI fell 3% overnight on a reported Gulf states meeting with Iran over the Strait. Midterm seasonality has not materialized, and Healthcare is the hedge if it does.
